# graphiant_playbook_templates (Data Source)

Starter playbook and sample module config templates for an Automation Workflows bundle, as published by the graphiant-playbooks collection version the service runs.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "graphiant_playbook_templates" "ntp" {
  bundle_key  = "system_bundle"
  module_keys = ["ntp"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `bundle_key` (String) Catalog bundle key, from graphiant_playbook_bundles.

### Optional

- `module_keys` (List of String) Narrow the response to these module keys; omit for the whole bundle (playbook plus every module sample).

### Read-Only

- `collection_version` (String) graphiant-playbooks collection version the templates come from.
- `files` (List of Object) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--files))

<a id="nestedatt--files"></a>
### Nested Schema for `files`

Read-Only:

- `content` (String)
- `filename` (String)
- `module_key` (String)
- `source_path` (String)
